caption: The drawing shows a statue of a standing human figure depicted in a side profile facing to the left. The statue is rendered in shades of brown and gold, giving it a metallic, bronze-like appearance. The figure is dressed in a short tunic with fringe at the hem, a sash, and moccasin-style footwear. The arms are crossed at the waist, and the figure wears a necklace and what appears to be a feathered headdress. The statue is positioned on a rectangular, brown pedestal. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color. The artist's name "Verna Tallman" appears in small, neat print at the lower right corner of the image.
title: Carved Wooden Indian
